title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Anions are used both as charge-balancing structural components and as templates, but multiply charged anions must be kept dilute enough to avoid rapid precipitation with rare-earth ions.
explanation: Metal aggregation creates large positive charge, so anion templating was introduced. Directly coordinating anions become part of the framework, while others act through nondirectional electrostatic induction. Low solubility products of multi-anions with rare earths make concentration control essential.
scope: IDA-stabilized 3d-4f cluster synthesis using anionic templates.
conditions: Controlled concentration of multiply charged anions during assembly.
caveats: Too much template anion favors precipitates rather than clusters.
